codeReview.summary: The feature successfully updated the tab bar colors/background treatment and the root stack already uses the required warm background, but it did not implement the requested Home/Farms/Logs/AI/More tab set and the Android active label still renders at weight 500 instead of 600.

issues.description: The visible tab triggers still render the existing IA/labels (`tabs.dashboard`, `tabs.explore`, `tabs.workers`, `tabs.tools`, `tabs.aiAssistant`) instead of the requested `Home`, `Farms`, `Logs`, `AI`, `More` bottom nav. The same mismatch remains in the iOS NativeTabs section (lines 236-283), so the feature does not fully match the required Cellar Ledger bottom-nav configuration.

On Android, `tabBarLabelStyle.fontWeight` is hard-coded to `500` for every state, so the active tab label never reaches the required 11px/600 styling. Only the iOS `NativeTabs` selected label gets `fontWeight: '600'`.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The mission shared state contains conflicting expectations for tab navigation. `architecture.md` says the app has 5 visible tabs `Home, Explore/Farms, Workers, Tools, Assistant` plus hidden `Settings/Farms`, while the feature description requires `Home, Farms, Logs, AI, More`. That conflict was not reconciled anywhere, which makes it easy for workers to treat the task as styling-only and miss the requested IA change.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/library/architecture.md (Navigation section) documents `Home, Explore/Farms, Workers, Tools, Assistant`; feature `update-tab-bar` in mission `features.json` requires `Home, Farms, Logs, AI, More`; current code in app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx lines 159-189 and 236-283 still follows the older tab set.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The `ui-worker` procedure says workers must read both the light and dark wireframes, but the transcript skeleton only shows `wireframe-D.html` being read before implementation while the handoff still reports `followedProcedure: true`. That means skill-compliance feedback for visual tasks is currently unreliable.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/skills/ui-worker/SKILL.md Step 2 and mission AGENTS.md both require reading light and dark wireframes; the transcript skeleton for worker session `58982a04-0116-400b-926d-b50e8bb78fc8` shows a `Read` of `wireframe-D.html` but no read of `wireframe-D-dark.html`; the handoff JSON marks `skillFeedback.followedProcedure` as true.

summary: Fail: the styling refresh landed, and root stack backgrounds/status bar are already compliant, but the feature did not implement the requested Home/Farms/Logs/AI/More tab set and Android active labels still use weight 500.
